name: xWays Hoarder xSplit®

features.name: xSplit Wilds
features.description: Split everything to the left on their row.

review:
A doomsday prepper's bunker. xSplit Wilds split every symbol to their left on the same row, and xWays reveal two to four symbols (all the same if several land).

Scatters trigger Bunker Raid Spins, where xWays turn sticky and can upgrade to super scatters, so the grid keeps growing through the bonus. High volatility, 11,030x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
